prompt:
TASK: Edit image 1. This is a local revision of the supplied artwork.
INPUT IMAGES (in supplied order):
Image 1: edit-target. Base image to edit; requested changes take precedence over preservation.
CHANGE REQUEST:
Remove the elderly man with glasses and walking stick and the young woman in the coral-pink kurti who sit in the two front waiting chairs at the left: they have already been called in. Leave those two blue waiting chairs EMPTY, drawn completely with their seats, backs and armrests visible, and nothing left on them. Recolour the two background patients seen from behind in the rear row so they wear plain grey and dark-brown clothes. Keep everything else exactly as it is: Ravi standing in the same pose, position and size, his light green shirt, the dark-brown shoulder bag on his left shoulder with his left hand on the strap and the wristwatch, his right hand at his trouser pocket, his face and upward gaze toward the wall TV; the wall TV at the upper right with its light-teal screen and one empty white strip; Meera typing at the reception desk at the right; the vitals cart, the QR stand by the glass entrance at the left, the plants, the lighting and the plain white area at the top-left corner. No text, numbers or logos anywhere.
PRESERVE: retain all areas, identity traits, acting, clothing, composition and lettering space outside the requested change. The change request overrides preservation where necessary; repair connected anatomy, contact objects and occlusion together. Supporting images supply only their stated roles. Do not copy their entire scene or pose.
OUTPUT: one edited image matching the target aspect. Do not add text, guide marks or a global style filter. Re-measure faces and mouths and inspect lettering space after adoption.
